mapper.select: SELECT fm.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(u.nickname, fm.nickname_snapshot) AS nickname, fm.role AS role, fm.joined_at AS joinedAt FROM family_member fm LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = fm.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE fm.family_id = #{familyId} AND fm.deleted = 0 ORDER BY fm.joined_at ASC, fm.id ASC

SELECT fm.user_id AS userId, CASE WHEN fm.deleted = 0 THEN COALESCE(u.nickname, fm.nickname_snapshot) ELSE fm.nickname_snapshot END AS nickname FROM family_member fm LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = fm.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE fm.family_id = #{familyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE family_member fm JOIN `user` u ON u.id = fm.user_id SET fm.nickname_snapshot = u.nickname, fm.deleted = 1, fm.updated_at = NOW() WHERE fm.family_id = #{familyId} AND fm.user_id = #{userId} AND fm.deleted = 0
UPDATE family_member fm JOIN `user` u ON u.id = fm.user_id SET fm.nickname_snapshot = u.nickname, fm.deleted = 1, fm.updated_at = NOW() WHERE fm.family_id = #{familyId} AND fm.deleted = 0

UPDATE family_member SET deleted = 0, role = #{role}, nickname_snapshot = #{nicknameSnapshot}, joined_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 1
